summary.text: Alan Martinez is a Republican state representative from New Mexico House District 23 who took office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Martinez was born in Española, New Mexico, and earned a B.A. in education and religion from Southern Arizona Bible College in 1986.
Martinez's career experience includes working as a manager at Rio Grand Sales and as a state benefits director with the New Mexico Department of Veteran Services.
In the 2025-2026 session, Martinez serves on the Rules and Order of Business Committee, the Health & Human Services Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
